lessons.title: Participant buckets
lessons.summary: Office language: CLIENT, REGISTERED, LEADS, WAITING, OLD — use only these labels.
steps: Five lists, one person in one list. LEADS asked for a code and did not finish the form. Only looked is a filter on Leads, not its own list.

REGISTERED finished the form and has never had a place. If they are also on the waiting list, the WAITING chip shows on this row. Pay hold and Lost slot are chips on that list. Outcome says why a Lost slot happened. Blocked the space: they went in and the seat was held, then the time ran out. Did not pay: a pay link was sent and the seat was not held. Office hold, not paid: the office kept it and they did not pay. Funding and Payment are not on this screen.

WAITING is a Booking Portal join for a full service. If they have no place now, they are also REGISTERED. The old CFK webhook export is not this list. Those people were interested and were never clients. They sit on CFK LEADS.
CLIENT (Active) has a place now. On Trial is a CLIENT sitting a trial seat, not a REGISTERED chip.
OLD had a place and has none from September 2026. A climbing trial or a crash course that already happened, with no place now, is OLD. A demo contact does not appear on these lists.

Funding and payment live on Active, OLD and On Trial. Leads and REGISTERED do not show those columns. On REGISTERED, Service and Time slot show what they asked for. A payments sheet row that is only a first name stays with the client who already had that name. A row marked merged retired stays off these lists.
tips: Do not say former / alumni in office chat — say OLD.
Kareena counted through Sun 28 Sep 2026. From Tue 29 Sep 2026 she is OLD.

es.title: Cubos de participantes
es.summary: Lenguaje de oficina: CLIENT, REGISTERED, LEADS, WAITING, OLD. Usa solo estas etiquetas.
es.where: Cubos de personas en el menu / filtros de CLIENT
steps: Cinco listas, una persona en una sola. LEADS pidio un codigo y no termino el formulario. Only looked es un filtro de Leads, no una lista aparte.

REGISTERED termino el formulario y nunca ha tenido plaza. Si tambien estan en la lista de espera, el chip WAITING sale en esta fila. Pay hold y Lost slot son chips de esa lista. Outcome dice por que es Lost slot. Blocked the space: entraron y la plaza quedo retenida, y se acabo el tiempo. Did not pay: se mando un enlace de pago y la plaza no quedo retenida. Office hold, not paid: la oficina la guardo y no pagaron. Funding y Payment no salen en esta pantalla.

WAITING es una entrada de Booking Portal para un servicio lleno. Si no tienen plaza ahora, tambien son REGISTERED. El export viejo del webhook de CFK no es esta lista. Estaban interesados y nunca fueron clientes. Estan en CFK LEADS.
CLIENT (Active) tiene plaza ahora. On Trial es un CLIENT sentado en un trial, no un chip de REGISTERED.
OLD tuvo plaza y no tiene desde septiembre 2026. Un trial de climbing o un crash course que ya paso, sin plaza ahora, es OLD. Un contacto de prueba no sale en estas listas.

Funding y payment viven en Active, OLD y On Trial. Leads y REGISTERED no ensenan esas columnas. En REGISTERED, Service y Time slot muestran lo que pidieron. Una fila de payments que solo tiene el nombre de pila se queda con el cliente que ya tenia ese nombre. Una fila marcada merged retired no sale en estas listas.
tips: En la oficina no digas former ni alumni. Di OLD.
Kareena conto hasta el domingo 28 Sep 2026. Desde el martes 29 Sep 2026 es OLD.

lessons.title: Centre a parent photo
lessons.summary: Parent uploads show the whole photo, centred, with no zoom. Click the photo on Active to drag and zoom, then Save.
lessons.where: CLIENT -> Active -> photo, or open the participant and click the photo
steps: Open CLIENT and stay on Active.
Click the participant photo (the list circle, or the photo next to the name once the profile is open).
Drag the picture until the face sits in the circle. Zoom 1 shows the whole photo. Move the slider only if you want it closer.
Save. Reset puts it back to the whole photo, centred. The same framing shows on staff Today and the other circles.
tips: Photos the office already had as a face crop stay as they were until you click and Save.

es.title: Centrar la foto de un padre
es.summary: Las fotos que suben los padres se ven enteras y centradas, sin zoom. En Active, pulsa la foto para moverla y hacer zoom, y guarda.
es.where: CLIENT -> Active -> foto, o abre el participante y pulsa la foto
steps: Abre CLIENT y quedate en Active.
Pulsa la foto (el circulo de la lista, o la foto junto al nombre cuando el perfil esta abierto).
Arrastra hasta que la cara quede en el circulo. Zoom 1 ensena la foto entera. Mueve el slider solo si la quieres mas cerca.
Save. Reset la deja otra vez entera y centrada. El mismo encuadre sale en Today del staff y en los otros circulos.
tips: Las fotos que ya eran un recorte de cara se quedan igual hasta que pulses y guardes.

lessons.title: What you do with the people on Leads
lessons.summary: Lead is OTP or Parent portal. Type is who they were. Outcome is Only looked, Waiting list, Trial, or Term.
steps: The page opens on Portal OTP only. Each row is a parent who asked for a code, or who opened Booking from the family hub.
Lead is how they came in. OTP means they asked for a code on the booking page. Parent portal means they were already in the family hub. No code.
Each row is one visit. The same parent can appear twice. Someone who is not ACTIVE has no parent-portal code, so they come in by OTP.

Type is who they were on that visit. New visitor, First time. Registered: they sent the form on that first visit. Did not register: they only asked for the code. Coming back by OTP, already registered and not ACTIVE, is Known visitor. The note Not first time. Registered previously means they registered before and have no place now. ACTIVE already has a place and can open the parent portal.

Outcome is what that visit did. Only looked stays on Leads. Waiting list also shows on WAITING. Trial also shows on TRIAL. Term also shows on Active. A first OTP visit that books a trial is Trial. Coming back later with OTP and booking the term is Term.

Parent / carer shows the name, then the email, then the phone. ACTIVE is the green chip. Under it is only the service they already have, not what they looked at. Booked Trial and Booked Term show that place under the chip. Only looked shows Filled the form or Edited information when that is what the visit was. Services they opened stay in Activity. Waiting list is the yellow chip.
Track status is not on the Portal OTP table. It stays on the office list. Booked takes that email off the marketing list. It does not change Outcome.

On Portal OTP, Search and Origin sit on one line. Origin stays on Portal OTP. The only chips are Outcome. Lead and Type stay as columns in the table. Track status is not on that screen. Writing to families is Family broadcast, under Clients and Families, Family.
Email interest is an old office file. Open it from Origin only when you want a marketing send.
Add / update potential client is not on the OTP screen. Open Origin: Office potential clients when you need to type a parent by hand. Save potential does not give them a place.
tips: Visits to the Booking Portal are not on this page. A visit is not a lead.

es.title: Que hacer con la gente de Leads
es.summary: Lead es OTP o Parent portal. Type es quien eran. Outcome es Only looked, Waiting list, Trial o Term.
steps: La pagina abre en Portal OTP. Cada fila es un padre que pidio un codigo, o que abrio Booking desde el hub de la familia.
Lead es como entraron. OTP: pidieron un codigo en Booking. Parent portal: ya estaban en el hub. Sin codigo.
Cada fila es una visita. El mismo padre puede salir dos veces. Quien no es ACTIVE no tiene codigo del parent portal, asi que entra por OTP.

Type es quien eran en esa visita. New visitor, First time. Registered: mandaron el formulario en esa primera visita. Did not register: solo pidieron el codigo. Si vuelven por OTP, ya registrados y no ACTIVE, es Known visitor. La nota Not first time. Registered previously significa que ya se registraron y no tienen plaza ahora. ACTIVE ya tiene plaza y puede abrir el parent portal.

Outcome es lo que hizo esa visita. Only looked se queda en Leads. Waiting list tambien sale en WAITING. Trial tambien sale en TRIAL. Term tambien sale en Active. La primera vez con OTP que reserva un trial es Trial. Si vuelve despues con OTP y reserva el term, es Term.

Parent / carer muestra el nombre, luego el email y luego el telefono. ACTIVE es el chip verde. Debajo va solo el servicio que ya tienen, no lo que miraron. Booked Trial y Booked Term llevan ese sitio debajo del chip. Only looked pone Filled the form o Edited information cuando la visita fue eso. Lo que abrieron se queda en Activity. Waiting list es el chip amarillo.
Track status no esta en la tabla de Portal OTP. Se queda en la lista de oficina. Booked saca ese email de la lista de marketing. No cambia Outcome.

En Portal OTP, Search y Origin van en una linea. Origin se queda en Portal OTP. Los unicos chips son Outcome. Lead y Type se quedan como columnas de la tabla. Track status no esta en esa pantalla. Escribir a familias es Family broadcast, en Clients and Families, Family.
Email interest es un archivo viejo de oficina. Abrelo en Origin solo cuando quieras un envio de marketing.
Add / update potential client no esta en la pantalla OTP. Abre Origin: Office potential clients cuando quieras escribir un padre a mano. Save potential no le da una plaza.
tips: Las visitas al Booking Portal no estan en esta pagina. Una visita no es un lead.

lessons.title: What Leads is
lessons.summary: A lead opened Booking. Lead is OTP or Parent portal. Outcome is what that visit did.
steps: This page is not the child list. Lead Parent portal means they opened Booking from the family hub. Lead OTP means they asked for a code.
Outcome Only looked: they stay on Leads. They did not join another list. Activity, next to Outcome, lists the services they opened.
Outcome Trial or Term: Activity shows that service, the time, the day and the venue.
Outcome Waiting list: they also show on WAITING. Outcome Trial: they also show on TRIAL. Outcome Term: they also show on Active.

Type is who they were. New visitor is the first time. Known visitor is someone who already registered and is not ACTIVE. Not first time. Registered previously means they registered before. Known visitor (OLD CLIENT) is an old client who came back as a visitor. ACTIVE already has a place.
Email interest is an old office file under Origin. It is not the lead list.
tips: REGISTERED, under Services & places, is the child who finished the form and has no place. That is a different screen.

es.title: Que es Leads
es.summary: Un lead abrio Booking. Lead es OTP o Parent portal. Outcome es lo que hizo esa visita.
steps: Esta pagina no es la lista de ninos. Lead Parent portal: abrieron Booking desde el hub. Lead OTP: pidieron un codigo.
Outcome Only looked: se quedan en Leads. No pasan a otra lista. Activity, al lado de Outcome, lista los servicios que abrieron.
Outcome Trial o Term: Activity muestra ese servicio, la hora, el dia y el venue.
Outcome Waiting list: tambien salen en WAITING. Outcome Trial: tambien salen en TRIAL. Outcome Term: tambien salen en Active.

Type es quien eran. New visitor es la primera vez. Known visitor es alguien que ya se registro y no es ACTIVE. Not first time. Registered previously significa que ya se registraron. Known visitor (OLD CLIENT) es un cliente OLD que volvio como visitante. ACTIVE ya tiene plaza.
Email interest es un archivo viejo de oficina, dentro de Origin. No es la lista de leads.
tips: REGISTERED, en Services & places, es el nino que termino el formulario y no tiene plaza. Es otra pantalla.

lessons.title: What each block on Leads does
lessons.summary: The page opens on Portal OTP. The chips are Outcome only. The number on a chip is how many visits it matches.
steps: Add / update potential client is not on Portal OTP. Set Origin to Office potential clients to type a parent by hand. Email is required. Save potential stores that parent on the office list.
Track status is on the office origin only. Leave it on New. Booked takes that email off the marketing list. It does not change Outcome.
On Portal OTP the only chips are Outcome. Lead and Type stay in the table. A chip with no visits stays hidden. The number on each chip is how many visits match it.
Search looks at name, email, phone, and the enquiry note. Origin stays on Portal OTP. Refresh reloads it. Writing to those people is Family broadcast, not this page.
Each table row is one parent. Outcome says what they did after the code. Open PDF opens a form when one is linked. The date is the last activity.
tips: Leave Origin on Portal OTP only. Email interest is only for a marketing send.

es.title: Que hace cada bloque de Leads
es.summary: La pagina abre en Portal OTP. Los chips son solo Outcome. El numero del chip es cuantas visitas coinciden.
steps: Add / update potential client no esta en Portal OTP. Pon Origin en Office potential clients para escribir un padre a mano. El email es obligatorio. Save potential lo guarda en la lista de oficina.
Track status solo esta en el origen de oficina. Dejalo en New. Booked saca ese email de la lista de marketing. No cambia Outcome.
En Portal OTP los unicos chips son Outcome. Lead y Type se quedan en la tabla. Un chip sin visitas no se muestra. El numero de cada chip es cuantas visitas coinciden.
Search mira nombre, email, telefono y la nota. Origin se queda en Portal OTP. Refresh la recarga. Escribir a esa gente es Family broadcast, no esta pagina.
Cada fila es un padre. Outcome dice que hizo despues del codigo. Open PDF abre un formulario cuando hay uno enlazado. La fecha es la ultima actividad.

lessons.title: How to email or WhatsApp people on Leads
lessons.summary: Leads only shows the visits. The message is written on Family broadcast.
steps: On Portal OTP the chips are Outcome only. They only change which visits you see.
Open Clients and Families, then Family, then Family broadcast to write the message.
Pick the audience there: in class, waiting list, OTP with no booking, or all.
Sending a message does not book a place and does not move the child to REGISTERED or ACTIVE.
tips: Family broadcast does not have Only looked, Trial or Term. Those filters stay on Leads.

es.title: Como escribir por email o WhatsApp a gente de Leads
es.summary: Leads solo muestra las visitas. El mensaje se escribe en Family broadcast.
steps: En Portal OTP los chips son solo Outcome. Solo cambian las visitas que ves.
Abre Clients and Families, luego Family, luego Family broadcast para escribir el mensaje.
Ahi eliges la audiencia: en clase, lista de espera, OTP sin reserva, o todos.
Enviar un mensaje no reserva una plaza y no mueve al nino a REGISTERED ni a ACTIVE.
tips: Family broadcast no tiene Only looked, Trial ni Term. Esos filtros se quedan en Leads.

lessons.title: How to add a parent who never opened the portal
lessons.summary: Use Add / update potential client. They join the outreach list unless you mark them Booked.
lessons.where: Services & places → Leads → Origin: Office potential clients
steps: Type the parent name, email, and phone. Email is required.
Activity is a note such as Aquatic Wed. Enquiry / notes is whatever they asked.
Leave track status as New unless you already know they will not book, or they are Booked.
Set Origin to Office potential clients. The form is on that list, not on Portal OTP.
Save potential. The row appears in that office list.
tips: Booked takes them off the automatic marketing list. Every other track status keeps them on it.

es.title: Como anadir un padre que nunca abrio el portal
es.summary: Usa Add / update potential client. Entra en la lista de contacto salvo que lo marques Booked.
es.where: Services & places → Leads → Origin: Office potential clients
steps: Escribe nombre del padre, email y telefono. El email es obligatorio.
Activity es una nota, por ejemplo Aquatic Wed. Enquiry / notes es lo que preguntaron.
Deja track status en New salvo que ya sepas que no van a reservar, o que estan Booked.
Pon Origin en Office potential clients. El formulario esta en esa lista, no en Portal OTP.
Save potential. La fila sale en esa lista de oficina.
tips: Booked les saca de la lista automatica de marketing. Cualquier otro track status les deja dentro.

lessons.title: What Leads is not
lessons.summary: Pay hold, Lost slot, REGISTERED, and CFK LEADS are other screens.
steps: REGISTERED is Services & places → REGISTERED. That child finished the registration form and has no place now. Service and Time slot show the trial they asked for: service, day, time, and place. The date is the day they registered.

On that REGISTERED list the chips are only All, Pay hold or Lost slot. Outcome is the column that splits Lost slot. Blocked the space: they went in and the seat was held, then the time ran out. Did not pay: a pay link was sent and the seat was not held. Office hold, not paid: the office kept it and they did not pay. Funding and Payment are not on this screen. The chip sits under the name. Active does not list this screen.
Someone who already has a place stays ACTIVE. They do not get the Pay hold or Lost slot chip.
CFK LEADS is a filter on the contacts table. It is the old Class for Kids file. It is not this Leads page.
Lost slot on Finance is a family who re-enrolled and did not pay. That chip is on the invoice, not on Leads.
tips: The i on each page is the manual for that screen. Leads does not book a seat.

es.title: Lo que Leads no es
es.summary: Pay hold, Lost slot, REGISTERED y CFK LEADS son otras pantallas.
steps: REGISTERED es Services & places → REGISTERED. Ese nino termino el formulario y no tiene plaza ahora. Service y Time slot muestran el trial que pidio: servicio, dia, hora y sitio. La fecha es el dia en que se registro.

En esa lista REGISTERED los chips son solo All, Pay hold o Lost slot. Outcome es la columna que separa Lost slot. Blocked the space: entraron y la plaza quedo retenida, y se acabo el tiempo. Did not pay: se mando un enlace de pago y la plaza no quedo retenida. Office hold, not paid: la oficina la guardo y no pagaron. Funding y Payment no salen en esta pantalla. El chip va bajo el nombre. Active no lista esta pantalla.
Quien ya tiene plaza se queda ACTIVE. No lleva el chip Pay hold ni Lost slot.
CFK LEADS es un filtro de la tabla de contactos. Es el archivo viejo de Class for Kids. No es esta pagina de Leads.
Lost slot en Finance es una familia que rehizo la inscripcion y no pago. Ese chip esta en la factura, no en Leads.
tips: La i de cada pagina es el manual de esa pantalla. Leads no reserva una plaza.

lessons.title: Leads and REGISTERED
lessons.summary: Leads is who asked for an OTP code. REGISTERED is a child who finished the form and has no place.
lessons.where: Services & places → Leads, and Services & places → REGISTERED
steps: Leads is not a second child list. It is parents who asked for an OTP code. The page opens on those people.
OTP leads counts those parents. It is not visits. Email interest is an old file under Origin, only for a marketing send.
On Portal OTP the chips are Outcome only. Writing to those parents is Family broadcast. It does not book a place.
Outcome Already a client means that parent already has a child in class. Already a client, registered again means they sent a new form.

REGISTERED is the contacts table. The child finished the form and has no place now. Service and Time slot show the trial they asked for: service, day, time, and place. The date is the day they registered.

On the REGISTERED screen the chips are only Pay hold or Lost slot, plus All. Pay hold means the seat is still held and payment is still due. If the time runs out and they have not paid, trial or term, it is Lost slot. Funding and Payment stay blank unless the form or an invoice stored them. The chip sits under the name. Someone who already has a place stays on Active and does not get that chip.
CFK LEADS is a filter on the contacts table, the old Class for Kids file. It is not the Leads page.
tips: Lost slot on Finance is a family who re-enrolled and did not pay. That chip is on the invoice, not on this Leads page.

es.title: Leads y REGISTERED
es.summary: Leads es quien pidio un codigo OTP. REGISTERED es un nino que termino el formulario y no tiene plaza.
es.where: Services & places → Leads, y Services & places → REGISTERED
steps: Leads no es una segunda lista de ninos. Son padres que pidieron un codigo OTP. La pagina abre con esa gente.
OTP leads cuenta esos padres. No son visitas. Email interest es un archivo viejo dentro de Origin, solo para un envio de marketing.
En Portal OTP los chips son solo Outcome. Escribir a esos padres es Family broadcast. No reserva una plaza.
Outcome Already a client quiere decir que ese padre ya tiene un nino en clase. Already a client, registered again quiere decir que mando un formulario nuevo.

REGISTERED es la tabla de contactos. El nino termino el formulario y no tiene plaza ahora. Service y Time slot muestran el trial que pidio: servicio, dia, hora y sitio. La fecha es el dia en que se registro.

En la pantalla REGISTERED los chips son solo Pay hold o Lost slot, mas All. Pay hold: la plaza sigue retenida y falta pagar. Si se acaba el tiempo y no pagan, trial o term, es Lost slot. Funding y Payment quedan vacios si el formulario o una factura no los guardaron. El chip va bajo el nombre. Quien ya tiene plaza se queda en Active y no lleva ese chip.
CFK LEADS es un filtro de la tabla de contactos, el archivo viejo de Class for Kids. No es la pagina Leads.
tips: Lost slot en Finance es una familia que rehizo la inscripcion y no pago. Ese chip esta en la factura, no en esta pagina de Leads.

lessons.title: CLIENT list and profiles
lessons.summary: Active, OLD CLIENTS, On Trial and CFK LEADS are their own screens. WAITING LIST and REGISTERED are theirs too. A person on WAITING does not also show under REGISTERED.
lessons.where: Clients & Families → Active, OLD CLIENTS, On Trial / Trialled, CFK LEADS. Services & places → WAITING LIST, REGISTERED
steps: Clients & Families in the left menu opens a screen with the same buttons. Under Clients: Active (on a place now), OLD CLIENTS, On Trial / Trialled, CFK LEADS, then Progress and Reports. Each of those lists is its own screen and only filters that list. Active does not switch to the others. WAITING LIST and REGISTERED are under Services & places, next to Places and Leads. REGISTERED is people who finished the form and have never had a place. Registration Form under Documents is every Booking Portal form, including people already in class. That page is not LEADS. Under Family: Photos/Videos, Family broadcast, Portal PINs (Family), Dashboard Teleport (Family). WhatsApp, family messages (P), staff messages (S), Comms (C) and Announcements (A) are the buttons in the top bar. The title is on the left. Back sits on the right.
The circle with i next to a page title opens what that page is for, plus the matching Office help steps. That text stays off the page.
ACTIVE: on a place now. A cancelled place is not ACTIVE. ACTIVE stays under the name, with the date of birth.
Support is the ratio, such as 1:1. Funding and Payment are separate columns. Funding is only one of three: Using Private funds (VAT 20%), Using LA funds (Exempt), or LA/NHS funded.

Payment can be more than one. The payment names are Bank Transfer (One off-Manually), Bank Transfer (Flexi-Manually), Apple Pay/Stripe, GoCardless, BACS (Ealing), Monthly Arrears (NHS), Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA), Monthly Arrears (H&F), and Payment Link. Payment Link is an invoice marked payment link that is paid or part-paid. A Stripe checkout on that link stays Payment Link. An unpaid link does not count. When Bookings and Payments has two funders for the same child, both chips show. Ealing is BACS (Ealing). NHS/ILA, including a Friday paid by them, is Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA).

On Active, OLD CLIENTS and On Trial, the filters sit next to Search: Support, Funding, Payment, Service. Open one. The row under it is only that filter. All is everyone on that screen. Changing filter clears the previous one, so Funding All is the whole list, not whoever was left from Payment. A payment chip keeps anyone who has that method, even if they also have another. A service chip keeps anyone who has that service, even if they also have another. Support is 1:1, 2:1 or 3:1. There is no Registration question dropdown on these screens.

Funding and Payment come from the invoice. VAT 20% means the family pays (Using Private funds). No VAT and the family pays means Using LA funds (Exempt). No VAT and the office bills the council or NHS means LA/NHS funded. Summer is used when that is the invoice on file. Each funding type and each payment method has its own colour.

OLD CLIENTS is its own screen under Clients & Families. They were in summer 2026, or had a September service, and are not here now. Someone who cancelled the service for the rest of term is on this screen too, with a Cancelled chip. Service is the service they were on. Last term on roster is the last term they were on the roster, such as Spring 2026 or Summer 2026. If the roster names them later than the old booking date, that later day wins. The newest term is always at the top. A row with no term stays at the bottom, in name order. Support, Funding, Payment and Service on that screen each filter the whole list. All shows everyone on the screen.

Someone who was never in summer is not OLD CLIENTS. A registration in September with no service stays REGISTERED. A Class for Kids waiting request with no booking stays old waiting list. A Class for Kids booking from September 2025 through August 2026 is OLD CLIENTS. The Class for Kids file with no booking in that window, and no waiting request, stays under CFK LEADS.

WAITING LIST under Services & places is its own screen. The chips on that screen are only All, Portal (Booking Portal from 12 Aug 2026), or Before the portal (CFK and the workbook from before that). Someone who already has a service is off Before the portal and stays on Active. Source shows Booking Portal or Workbook. Funding and Payment are not on this screen. Newest join is at the top. A child who already has a service can also be on the Portal waiting list for another place. OTP with no finished registration stays in LEADS, not on these lists.

REGISTERED: filled the registration form, no term place, not on a waiting list. The Registered column is the day they registered, newest at the top. Someone who only comes to crash courses stays here, with Service set to Crash courses, so you can offer them a term place.

CFK LEADS is its own screen under Clients & Families. It is the Class for Kids contact file, not the Leads page. Funding and Payment are not on this screen. Age comes from the date of birth on that file. Service says Class for Kids. The time column is the first and last booking date from that file, when the file has them. The line under the status says Class for Kids file.

On Trial / Trialled is its own screen under Clients & Families. Someone who booked a trial and has a trial session. Booked is the day they booked. Service and Time slot are that trial, not the place they have now. Trial session is only the day, plus On Trial or Trialled. A session still ahead is On Trial. A session already held is Trialled. Newest session is at the top. They stay on Active as well when they took a term place afterwards.
Search stays inside the screen you opened. It does not pull people from the other lists.

A short name on the bookings shows on that child's row when it is the same person. Consecutive halves on the same day show as one time. The venue is in brackets after the time, such as Tuesday, 3:30 pm to 5:00 pm (SWIMFARM).
Age uses the date of birth. If the contact has no date, the list uses the birth line on the registration (Clients Info).
Contact, email, phone and age come from the child's contact record. A short roster name still shows that parent and those details.
A group label such as a Day Centre block is not an extra client when the children in that group are already on the list. Tuesday ACAT 11-12 shows as Aquatic Activity on each member, at SwimFarm.
Direct Payments sit under Using LA funds (Exempt). The family pays. LA/NHS funded means the office bills the authority.

The Photo column is that child's own picture. A picture the parent uploaded or replaced in the portal is the one that shows. Until then, the office picture shows when we have one. If neither side has a picture, the initials show.
Do not put WAITING, REGISTERED, CFK LEADS or OLD CLIENTS on Sessions as booked kids.
tips: A shared first name does not share a photo. Each row keeps that child's own face.

The Registered column is the registration date on the contact. If that date is empty, it is the day the child was added in the portal. Date of birth is not that day. If neither date is on file, the cell says Not on file.
A one-word name on the bookings is one child. Another child with that first name does not take the place.

es.title: Lista CLIENT y fichas
es.summary: Active, OLD CLIENTS, On Trial y CFK LEADS son pantallas propias. WAITING LIST y REGISTERED tambien. Alguien en WAITING no sale tambien en REGISTERED.
es.where: Clients & Families → Active, OLD CLIENTS, On Trial / Trialled, CFK LEADS. Services & places → WAITING LIST, REGISTERED
steps: Clients & Families abre Active (con plaza ahora), OLD CLIENTS, On Trial / Trialled, CFK LEADS, luego Progress y Reports. Cada lista es su pantalla y solo filtra esa lista. Active no cambia a las otras. WAITING LIST y REGISTERED estan en Services & places, al lado de Places y Leads. REGISTERED es quien termino el formulario y nunca ha tenido plaza. Registration Form, en Documents, es cada formulario del Booking Portal, tambien gente que ya esta en clase. Esa pagina no es LEADS. En Family estan Photos/Videos, Family broadcast, Portal PINs (Family) y Dashboard Teleport (Family). WhatsApp, P, S, C y A son los botones de la barra. El titulo va a la izquierda. Back va a la derecha.
La i al lado del titulo abre para que sirve la pagina y los pasos de Office help. Ese texto no se queda en la pagina.
ACTIVE: tiene plaza ahora. Una plaza cancelada no es ACTIVE. ACTIVE va bajo el nombre, con la fecha de nacimiento.
Support es el ratio, por ejemplo 1:1. Funding y Payment son columnas distintas. Funding es solo una de tres: Using Private funds (VAT 20%), Using LA funds (Exempt), o LA/NHS funded.

Payment puede ser mas de uno. Los nombres son Bank Transfer (One off-Manually), Bank Transfer (Flexi-Manually), Apple Pay/Stripe, GoCardless, BACS (Ealing), Monthly Arrears (NHS), Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA), Monthly Arrears (H&F) y Payment Link. Payment Link es una factura marcada payment link que esta pagada o pagada en parte. Un checkout de Stripe en ese enlace sigue siendo Payment Link. Un enlace sin pagar no cuenta. Si Bookings and Payments tiene dos pagadores para el mismo nino, salen los dos chips. Ealing es BACS (Ealing). NHS/ILA, incluido un viernes pagado por ellos, es Monthly Arrears (NHS/ILA).

En Active, OLD CLIENTS y On Trial, los filtros van al lado de Search: Support, Funding, Payment, Service. Abre uno. La fila de abajo es solo ese filtro. All es toda la gente de esa pantalla. Al cambiar de filtro se quita el anterior, asi que Funding All es la lista entera, no quien quedaba de Payment. Un chip de pago deja a quien tiene ese metodo, aunque tenga otro tambien. Un chip de servicio deja a quien tiene ese servicio, aunque tenga otro tambien. Support es 1:1, 2:1 o 3:1. En estas pantallas no hay dropdown de Registration question.

Funding y Payment salen de la factura. VAT 20% quiere decir que paga la familia (Using Private funds). Sin VAT y paga la familia quiere decir Using LA funds (Exempt). Sin VAT y la oficina factura al council o al NHS quiere decir LA/NHS funded. Summer se usa cuando esa es la factura que hay. Cada tipo de funding y cada metodo de pago tiene su color.

OLD CLIENTS es su pantalla en Clients & Families. Estuvieron en verano 2026, o tuvieron un servicio en septiembre, y ahora no estan. Quien cancelo el servicio el resto del term tambien esta aqui, con un chip Cancelled. Service es el servicio que tenian. Last term on roster es el ultimo term en el que estuvieron en el roster, por ejemplo Spring 2026 o Summer 2026. Si el roster los nombra mas tarde que la reserva vieja, gana ese dia. El term mas reciente queda siempre arriba. Una fila sin term se queda abajo, por nombre. Support, Funding, Payment y Service filtran cada uno la lista entera. All ensena a todos en la pantalla.

Quien nunca estuvo en verano no es OLD CLIENTS. Un registro de septiembre sin servicio se queda REGISTERED. Una peticion de espera de Class for Kids sin reserva se queda en old waiting list. Una reserva de Class for Kids de septiembre 2025 a agosto 2026 es OLD CLIENTS. El archivo de Class for Kids sin reserva en esa ventana, y sin peticion de espera, se queda en CFK LEADS.

WAITING LIST en Services & places es su pantalla. Los chips son solo All, Portal (Booking Portal desde el 12 Aug 2026), o Before the portal (CFK y el workbook de antes). Quien ya tiene un servicio sale de Before the portal y se queda en Active. Source dice Booking Portal o Workbook. Funding y Payment no estan en esta pantalla. El alta mas reciente va arriba. Un nino que ya tiene un servicio puede estar tambien en la lista Portal para otra plaza. OTP sin registro terminado se queda en LEADS, no en estas listas.

REGISTERED: relleno el formulario, no tiene plaza de term, y no esta en lista de espera. La columna Registered es el dia en que se registro, el mas reciente arriba. Quien solo viene a crash courses se queda aqui, con Service en Crash courses, para poder ofrecerle una plaza de term.

CFK LEADS es su pantalla en Clients & Families. Es el archivo de contactos de Class for Kids, no la pagina Leads. Funding y Payment no estan en esta pantalla. La edad sale de la fecha de nacimiento de ese archivo. Service dice Class for Kids. La columna de hora es la primera y la ultima fecha de reserva de ese archivo, cuando el archivo las tiene. La linea bajo el estado dice Class for Kids file.

On Trial / Trialled es su pantalla en Clients & Families. Alguien que reservo un trial y tiene una sesion de trial. Booked es el dia en que reservo. Service y Time slot son ese trial, no la plaza que tiene ahora. Trial session es solo el dia, mas On Trial o Trialled. Una sesion que todavia no ha llegado es On Trial. Una sesion ya dada es Trialled. La sesion mas reciente va arriba. Siguen en Active tambien si despues cogieron una plaza de term.
Search se queda en la pantalla que abriste. No trae gente de las otras listas.

Un nombre corto de las reservas sale en la fila de ese nino cuando es la misma persona. Dos medias seguidas el mismo dia se ven como una hora. La sede va entre parentesis despues de la hora, por ejemplo Tuesday, 3:30 pm to 5:00 pm (SWIMFARM).
La edad usa la fecha de nacimiento. Si el contacto no tiene fecha, la lista usa la linea de nacimiento del registro (Clients Info).
Contacto, email, telefono y edad salen del registro de contacto del nino. Un nombre corto del roster sigue ensenando a ese padre y esos datos.

Una etiqueta de grupo, como un bloque de Day Centre, no es un cliente extra cuando los ninos de ese grupo ya estan en la lista. El martes ACAT 11-12 sale como Aquatic Activity en cada miembro, en SwimFarm.
Direct Payments va bajo Using LA funds (Exempt). Paga la familia. LA/NHS funded quiere decir que la oficina factura a la autoridad.

La columna Photo es la foto de ese nino. La foto que el padre subio o cambio en el portal es la que se ve. Hasta entonces se ve la foto de oficina, si la hay. Si no hay foto de ninguno de los dos lados, salen las iniciales.
No pongas WAITING, REGISTERED, CFK LEADS ni OLD CLIENTS en Sessions como ninos reservados.
tips: Un nombre de pila compartido no comparte foto. Cada fila guarda la cara de ese nino.

La columna Registered es la fecha de registro del contacto. Si esa fecha esta vacia, es el dia en que se anadio el nino en el portal. La fecha de nacimiento no es ese dia. Si no hay ninguna de las dos, la celda dice Not on file.
Un nombre de una sola palabra en las reservas es un nino. Otro nino con ese nombre de pila no se queda la plaza.

lessons.title: Participant photo missing on the parent hub
lessons.summary: Initials and No photo on file mean nothing is stored yet. The hub does not invent a picture.
lessons.where: Parent hub, under the child circle
steps: Open the parent hub for that child.
If the circle shows initials and No photo on file, there is no saved photo on the participant.
The parent presses Add photo under the circle and chooses a picture.
Refresh the hub. The photo then shows for the family and for staff.
tips: A child added without a registration photo stays on initials until someone adds one.
Staff only see the photo after it is saved. A picture on a phone or in email does not appear by itself.

lessons.title: Waiting list is Booking Portal
lessons.summary: WAITING LIST is Booking Portal joins. Someone with no place now is also REGISTERED. The old CFK webhook is not this list.
steps: Open Services & places → WAITING LIST. That screen is only Booking Portal joins. Active does not open it.
The chips on this screen are All and Portal. Portal is a Booking Portal join.
Someone on this list with no place now is also REGISTERED. They show on both screens. Someone who already has a service can still wait here for another place.
The old CFK webhook export is not this list. Those people were interested and were never clients. They sit on CFK LEADS. A past client from that file who registered, with no place now, is OLD.
The list is newest join at the top and oldest at the bottom. Not on file sits at the bottom.
Funding and Payment are hidden. They fill in on ACTIVE when the child has a service.
OTP with no finished registration stays in LEADS. Do not add a separate OTP-only filter on this list.

On Booking, a full time sends a new visitor to registration first, then onto this list. Someone who is already REGISTERED or ACTIVE joins with the short form. The old name-only join did not collect the registration.
When a place opens (Services / Edit term slot / finish-booking), move them through your usual offer flow.
tips: A full seat does not get held by the waiting list.
Do not look for the old webhook names on this screen. They are on CFK LEADS.

es.title: La lista de espera es Booking Portal
es.summary: WAITING LIST son entradas de Booking Portal. Quien no tiene plaza ahora tambien es REGISTERED. El webhook viejo de CFK no es esta lista.
steps: Abre Services & places → WAITING LIST. Esa pantalla es solo entradas de Booking Portal. Active no la abre.
Los chips de esta pantalla son All y Portal. Portal es una entrada de Booking Portal.
Quien esta en esta lista y no tiene plaza ahora tambien es REGISTERED. Sale en las dos pantallas. Quien ya tiene un servicio puede seguir esperando aqui otra plaza.

El export viejo del webhook de CFK no es esta lista. Estaban interesados y nunca fueron clientes. Estan en CFK LEADS. Un cliente de antes de ese archivo, que se registro y no tiene plaza ahora, es OLD.
La lista pone arriba quien se apunto mas reciente y abajo el mas antiguo. Not on file se queda abajo.
Funding y Payment van ocultos. Se rellenan en ACTIVE cuando el nino tiene un servicio.
OTP sin registro terminado se queda en LEADS. No anadas un filtro solo de OTP en esta lista.

En Booking, una hora llena manda a un visitante nuevo al registro primero, y luego a esta lista. Quien ya es REGISTERED o ACTIVE entra con el formulario corto. El alta antigua solo con el nombre no recibia el registro.
Cuando se abre una plaza (Services / Edit term slot / finish-booking), pasalos por el camino de oferta de siempre.
tips: Una plaza llena no queda retenida por la lista de espera.
No busques los nombres del webhook viejo en esta pantalla. Estan en CFK LEADS.

lessons.title: What parents see vs office
lessons.summary: Parent hub chips and Team names vs office-only chrome.
steps: Parents see term chips: cancelled, absent, cover name when a real cover is assigned.
Parents do not see instructor day off / COVER NEEDED / Cover TBC.

categories.title: Finance
categories.blurb: Invoices, payments, Direct Payment mandate, refunds, credits and make-ups.

lessons.title: Help a parent authorise Direct Payment (GoCardless)
lessons.summary: Phone script for families who still need to authorise the bank mandate. Office cannot do this for them.
lessons.where: Parent portal → child / invoices → Set up Direct Payment (not admin Finance)

demos.caption: What the parent sees: blinking red Set up Direct Payment on the invoice card.
Office: ask Who has not authorised Direct Payment? for the live list.

steps: Ask them to open the Parent portal: https://www.clubsensational.org/parent and sign in (PIN / email on file).
Open the child / invoices / payment area for that family.
Find the blinking red button: Set up Direct Payment.
They tap it — GoCardless opens so they can authorise Direct Debit with their bank.
They complete bank authorisation (app / online banking as GoCardless asks).
Back in the parent portal it should show Direct Payment set up (mandate active). Later invoices collect on due dates.
tips: Office cannot authorise the mandate for them — the payer must finish GoCardless.
If they do not see the button: refresh; confirm the path is Direct Payment (GoCardless), not bank transfer / Flexi only; office can resend parent portal access / PIN.
Use this when they already chose Direct Payment but never finished bank authorisation.

lessons.title: GoCardless months on an invoice
lessons.summary: Autumn monthly GoCardless is 4 instalments (Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec). The chip counts those instalments. A green month is a collection GoCardless has already paid out.
steps: Open the family. The chip on the name is instalments already collected, for example 2 of 4 paid.
Inside the invoice, each month is its own row. Paid is green and shows the GoCardless payment. Scheduled is the next month, not due yet. Hidden is a later month.
Two collections so far (early September and 2 October) means September and October Paid, November Scheduled, December Hidden.
1 of 3 paid is a plan that starts in October (3 months left), not the second collection of a 4-month plan.
tips: The old chip 1 partially paid meant one invoice still open. It did not mean one instalment.
GoCardless creates the later months in advance. Pending in GoCardless is not Paid on the invoice until that collection pays out.
A month goes green only when that collection has paid out. The October collection must not paint November.

es.title: Meses de GoCardless en la factura
es.summary: GoCardless mensual de Autumn son 4 cuotas (sep, oct, nov, dic). El chip cuenta esas cuotas. Un mes en verde es un cobro que GoCardless ya ha pagado.
es.where: Finance → Bookings → la factura de la familia
steps: Abre la familia. El chip del nombre son las cuotas ya cobradas, por ejemplo 2 of 4 paid.
Dentro de la factura, cada mes es una fila. Paid en verde es el cobro de GoCardless. Scheduled es el mes siguiente, aun no toca. Hidden es un mes posterior.
Dos cobros hasta ahora (principios de septiembre y el 2 de octubre) = septiembre y octubre Paid, noviembre Scheduled, diciembre Hidden.
1 of 3 paid es un plan que empieza en octubre (quedan 3 meses), no el segundo cobro de un plan de 4.
tips: El chip viejo 1 partially paid era una factura aun abierta. No era una cuota.
GoCardless crea los meses siguientes por adelantado. Pending en GoCardless no es Paid en la factura hasta que ese cobro sale.
Un mes se pone verde solo cuando ese cobro ha salido. El cobro de octubre no debe pintar noviembre.

lessons.title: NHS invoices every 4 weeks (28 days)
lessons.summary: NHS pays a weekly package over 7 days, in blocks of 4 weeks. Do not send a calendar month counted in attendance days.
lessons.where: Finance → the NHS Day Centre invoice (PO XXPRASHERV1)
steps: Invoice Monday to Sunday, 28 days, four complete weeks. Not 1st to 30th/31st.
One line only. Quantity 4. Unit price is the weekly package: attendance days in that week times the agreed day rate (with the September uplift). Amount is 4 times that week.
Do not put the day rate as the unit price, and do not put the number of days in the month as the quantity. Their system splits the week over 7 days itself.
The Reference box at the top is the month only, for example September 2026. The 4-week dates stay on the service line, not in that box.

Day Centre started Tuesday 1 Sep 2026. The first invoice is the week of that start, four full weeks: Monday 31 Aug 2026 to Sunday 27 Sep 2026. 31 Aug is only the Monday their week starts. Service on the invoice is from 1 Sep. Charge the full weekly package for that first week.
Next block is Monday 28 Sep 2026 to Sunday 25 Oct 2026, then every 28 days.
Calendar-month invoices already sent (September counted in days) need a credit and a replacement 4-week invoice. Do not send the next month the old way.
tips: The weekly cost stays the same. Only the period and the line shape change.
1-4 Sep 2026 are inside the first 28-day invoice. They are part of the week of 1 Sep, charged as the full week.
Same shape if they query an after-school NHS invoice that was billed per session inside a calendar month: 4 times the weekly package, not a list of single days.

es.title: Facturas NHS cada 4 semanas (28 dias)
es.summary: El NHS paga un paquete semanal repartido en 7 dias, en bloques de 4 semanas. No mandes un mes natural contado en dias de asistencia.
es.where: Finance → la factura NHS de Day Centre (PO XXPRASHERV1)
steps: Factura de lunes a domingo, 28 dias, cuatro semanas completas. No del 1 al 30/31.

Una sola linea. Cantidad 4. El precio unitario es el paquete de la semana: dias de asistencia de esa semana por la tarifa de dia acordada (con la subida de septiembre). El importe es 4 veces esa semana.
No pongas la tarifa de dia como precio unitario, ni el numero de dias del mes como cantidad. Su sistema parte la semana en 7 dias solo.
El recuadro Reference de arriba es solo el mes, por ejemplo September 2026. Las fechas de las 4 semanas van en la linea del servicio, no en ese recuadro.

El Day Centre empezo el martes 1 sep 2026. La primera factura es la semana de ese arranque, cuatro semanas enteras: lunes 31 ago 2026 a domingo 27 sep 2026. El 31 ago es solo el lunes en que empieza su semana. En la factura el servicio es desde el 1 sep. Esa primera semana se cobra entera.
El siguiente bloque es lunes 28 sep 2026 a domingo 25 oct 2026, y luego cada 28 dias.
Las facturas de mes natural ya enviadas (septiembre contado en dias) necesitan un abono y una factura nueva de 4 semanas. No mandes el mes siguiente como antes.
tips: El coste semanal no cambia. Cambian el periodo y la forma de la linea.
El 1-4 sep 2026 van dentro de la primera factura de 28 dias. Son parte de la semana del 1 sep, cobrada como semana entera.
La misma forma si preguntan por una factura NHS de after-school cobrada por sesion dentro de un mes natural: 4 veces el paquete semanal, no una lista de dias sueltos.

lessons.title: Send H&F, NHS/ILA and NHS invoices to Sevitha
lessons.summary: From October, H&F and NHS/ILA go to admin@ at 9am on the 25th. NHS goes at 9am on the 20th.
lessons.where: Finance → the month's H&F, NHS/ILA and NHS invoices
steps: From October, at 9am London on the 25th, the portal emails that month's H&F invoices and NHS/ILA invoices to admin@clubsensational.org.
At 9am London on the 20th it emails that month's NHS invoices to the same address.

Each email has the PDF attached. The Reference on the PDF stays the month, for example September 2026.

lessons.title: Absents, refunds and credits
lessons.summary: Decide missed sessions: no action, credit, refund path, or close.
steps: One day with no instructor: Schedule and Covers, that date, Change on the child's card, then Cancelled. Do not use Absent. Absent is the family missing the session.
In Reason write that there is no instructor. Do not ask them to reply on this message. Save. That day only is cancelled. The standing service stays.
The parent gets an automatic WhatsApp that the session is cancelled, including that note. It says the message was sent automatically. The row lands in Absents, refunds and credits.

When the family tells the office refund or credit another way, open that row. Choose Credit or Refund, then Approve. For a refund enter the session amount. For a credit enter the same amount, or leave the amount blank for a session credit with no cash figure.

Approve writes the family ledger and sends the outcome message. A refund message asks for the name on the account, sort code, and account number so the office can pay it in. Makeup is only if they ask for another day.
tips: Sep+ absents and cancellations share one decide queue.
On Family credits and refunds, Edit note is for the office only. The parent sees the credit or refund, not that note, and gets no message when you save it.
If the family already uploaded proof, the row stays on Open after the 2 weeks so you can still choose credit, refund or makeup.

Automatic API messages (instructor change, time change, cancel, makeup confirm) say they are automatic and not to reply on that WhatsApp. The reply goes in Messages in the parent portal, or by call or message on 07592 558671.

Private pay-in-advance cancellation: unused prepaid can be refunded with a fee of 10% of the unused amount (minimum £25, maximum £100). Sessions already delivered, including a summer crash course, stay paid. LA / NHS do not use this fee.

Cancelling the standing place is Edit term slot. Set the anchor to a date on that weekday, then Rest of term from the anchor. The refund told to the parent is written under that participant, Payments, Cancel refund, and on this ledger. Mark paid back when that money has gone back. The programme payments row still shows what they paid in.

Finance month: refund goes on the month the office tramites Cancel service or Approve refund, not the bank payout date. Calendar anchor can be a later date that is not the child's weekday (e.g. Kareena told 29 Sep, anchor 6 Oct not her Tuesday — still September on the sheet; bank line (Pagado, 8 Oct)). Orla £236.25 is September. Emmanuel / Elias tramitados in October stay on October.

CEO finance sheet line shape: concept; refunds add Xero CN-... or CN pendiente; then (Pagado, d Sep), (Pagado, d Oct), or (Sin pagar) for bank date; IVA F rows end with IVA £... to reclaim. Addison Lee cabs: own dated block; IVA is VAT on booking or priority fees on the invoice, not one sixth of the fare gross.

Mark refunded opens one modal: office note, then an optional tick Notify parent (WhatsApp + email that the refund was sent). Leave the tick off unless the money already left the bank — default is ledger + Xero CN only. Same modal from participant Payments Mark paid back. Sync Xero CN uses the same tick if you only need Xero later. Paid invoices in Xero may not take API allocation; authorised CN + bank payout is still fine.

Cancel service should leave everything square: void future instalments on the portal invoice schedule, open refund on Family credits, cancelled chips on the parent hub, roster ends from the anchor. Check GoCardless / Stripe so nothing still collects after void.

es.title: Faltas, reembolsos y creditos
es.summary: Decide las sesiones perdidas: nada, credito, camino de reembolso, o cerrar.
steps: Un dia sin instructor: Schedule & Covers, esa fecha, Change en la tarjeta del nino, y luego Cancelled. No uses Absent. Absent es la familia que falta a la sesion.
En Reason escribe que no hay instructor. No pidas que contesten en ese mensaje. Guarda. Solo ese dia se cancela. El servicio fijo se queda.
El padre recibe un WhatsApp automatico de que la sesion esta cancelada, con esa nota. Dice que el mensaje salio solo. La fila cae en Absents, refunds and credits.

Cuando la familia diga a la oficina refund o credit por otro lado, abre esa fila. Elige Credit o Refund, y luego Approve. En un refund pon el importe de la sesion. En un credit pon el mismo importe, o dejalo en blanco para un credito de sesion sin cifra.

Approve escribe el libro de la familia y manda el mensaje del resultado. El mensaje de refund pide el nombre de la cuenta, sort code y account number para poder hacer el ingreso. Makeup solo si piden otro dia.
tips: Las faltas y cancelaciones de septiembre en adelante comparten una sola cola de decision.
En Family credits and refunds, Edit note es solo para la oficina. El padre ve el credito o el refund, no esa nota, y no recibe mensaje al guardarla.
Si la familia ya subio la prueba, la fila se queda en Open despues de las 2 semanas para poder elegir credit, refund o makeup.

Los mensajes automaticos de la API (cambio de instructor, cambio de hora, cancelacion, makeup confirmado) dicen que son automaticos y que no contesten en ese WhatsApp. La respuesta va en Messages del portal de padres, o por llamada o mensaje al 07592 558671.

Cancelacion de pago privado por adelantado: lo no usado se puede devolver con una tasa del 10% de lo no usado (minimo 25 libras, maximo 100). Las sesiones ya dadas, incluido un crash de verano, siguen pagadas. LA / NHS no usan esta tasa.

Cancelar la plaza fija es Edit term slot. Pon el ancla en una fecha de ese dia de la semana, y luego Rest of term from the anchor. El reembolso que se le dijo al padre queda en ese participante, Payments, Cancel refund, y en este libro. Mark paid back cuando ese dinero ya ha vuelto. La fila de programme payments sigue mostrando lo que pagaron.

Mes en la hoja: el refund va en el mes en que la oficina tramita Cancel service o Approve refund, no en la fecha del banco. La ancla en calendario puede ser un dia que no es su weekday (Kareena aviso 29 sep, ancla 6 oct no era su martes — sigue en septiembre; en fila (Pagado, 8 Oct)). Orla £236.25 septiembre. Emmanuel / Elias tramitados en octubre van en octubre.

Forma de fila en la hoja CEO: concepto; en refunds Xero CN-... o CN pendiente; luego (Pagado, d Sep), (Pagado, d Oct) o (Sin pagar) = fecha banco; filas IVA F cierran con IVA £... para reclamar. Cabs Addison Lee: bloque propio por fecha; IVA = VAT de fees en factura, no un sexto del viaje.

Mark refunded abre un modal: nota de oficina y una casilla opcional Notify parent (WhatsApp + email de que el refund ya se envio). Dejala sin marcar salvo que el dinero ya salio del banco — por defecto solo libro + CN en Xero. El mismo modal sale en participant Payments Mark paid back. Sync Xero CN usa la misma casilla si solo falta Xero. Facturas ya pagadas en Xero pueden no aceptar asignacion por API; CN autorizado + banco sigue valiendo.

Cancel service debe dejar todo cuadrado: anular plazos futuros en la factura del portal, refund abierto en Credits, chips cancelados en el hub del padre, roster cortado desde el ancla. Revisa GoCardless / Stripe para que no cobre despues del void.

lessons.title: Cancel a makeup and give a new one
lessons.summary: Makeup grants live on Absents, refunds and credits. Schedule and Covers shows the seat only after the family accepts and it is on the roster.
lessons.where: Absents, refunds and credits → Makeup grants
steps: Open Absents, refunds and credits, then Makeup grants. The grant is not a row on Schedule and Covers until the family accepts it.
While the status is Open: Offer slot to name a day, or Cancel grant to drop it. Then Add makeup to issue a new open grant, and Offer slot again.
While the status is Offered (the family has not accepted yet): Withdraw offer to take the day back, or Cancel grant. The grant returns to Open so you can offer another day.

When the family Accepts in the parent portal, the makeup is written onto that day's roster. The grant then says On roster. Sessions Overview and Staff show that card on the makeup date. The admin bell shows Makeup accepted. A reply on WhatsApp does not accept.

On roster has no Cancel grant. To drop that one day, open Schedule and Covers on the makeup date, Change on that card, then Undo change. Do not use Cancelled: that sends a cancellation and opens a new Absents row.

The old On roster grant cannot be offered again. Add makeup for a new open grant, then Offer slot. Date is YYYY-MM-DD, time like 6 to 6.30, instructor name required. The new day paints on Schedule and Covers when the family Accepts.
tips: Back to decide is only while the grant is still Open or Offered. On roster does not go back to the decide queue. Undo that day on Schedule and Covers, then Add makeup.
Move to another slot today only moves inside that same date. Another week is Undo on the old day, then a new grant and Offer slot.

Add makeup: type the first letters of the name, pick the centre, then an open seat (their instructor or another instructor) and the day. Send to parent. They Accept or Decline in the parent portal. The seat is not on the roster until they Accept.

The seat list for a date shows that instructor's turns, plus a seat that is free because a child is Absent that day (the name on the chip is the child who is away). Open seats with other workers stay on the list too.
Leave Only this date empty. The list then shows every upcoming free day at that venue through 20 Dec, including each Wednesday a child is absent. Pick the row with the date you want.

Send offer to parent does not put the child on the roster. The family sees Accept and Decline in the parent portal. The yellow makeup chip appears only after they Accept, and that same Accept paints the seat on Sessions Overview, Schedule and Covers, and Staff.
The parent card shows the session and the instructor name only. Do not put office words on it (Absents, decide queue, admin).
Absent date stays the original missed day. If that makeup day is cancelled and you offer another day, the new row still shows the original date.
If a makeup was placed on a seat that is not on that day's roster, Schedule and Covers still shows that name so you can open Change and Undo change.

lessons.title: WhatsApp template with gaps

In the body, paste four boxes with a blank line between them, then the fixed closing lines.

Parents use portal_parent_update_v3. Staff use portal_staff_update_v3. The chat name and the round logo are not part of the template.

Padres usan portal_parent_update_v3. Staff usa portal_staff_update_v3. El nombre del chat y el logo redondo no van en la plantilla.

Si Meta dice que la categoria no coincide y recomienda Marketing, pulsa Cancelar. Deja Servicio. Cambia la primera linea para que sea un aviso de una reserva que ya existe, no una presentacion del portal.
